name: Paperclip Migration
description: Migrate TeamHQ's agent orchestration to Paperclip, an open-source control plane for AI agent companies. Preserves our pipeline workflow, agent personas, and institutional knowledge while gaining automated execution, cost tracking, and session persistence.

subtasks: Read Marco's technical research brief on Paperclip (architecture, adapter system, heartbeat model, database schema)
Analyzed Paperclip's flat ticketing model vs. our sequential pipeline — identified Thomas-as-orchestrator as the v0.1 approach
Scoped v0.1 to 5 core agents (Thomas, Andrei, Robert, Alice, Enzo) — minimum viable pipeline
Defined agent configuration table with adapter types, instruction file paths, and heartbeat schedules
Designed persona porting strategy: thin wrapper files that include original personas + Paperclip API overrides
Documented gains (autonomous execution, cost tracking, session persistence, audit trail) vs. losses (simplicity, direct control, bus factor risk)
Identified 6 risks with severity ratings and mitigations
Defined 3 migration phases: v0.1 proof of concept, v0.2 full team, v0.3 operational maturity
Recommended non-standard pipeline (Andrei + Kai -> Milo -> Enzo) — no design/frontend/backend work needed
Raised 4 open questions for CEO decision
decisions: Thomas-as-orchestrator over custom plugin for pipeline sequencing — simpler to implement, leverages existing persona, can be replaced by plugin in v0.3 if unreliable
5 core agents for v0.1 instead of all 24 — proves the concept without configuration overhead
Only Thomas gets a scheduled heartbeat; all others are event-triggered — mirrors current CEO-driven model with Thomas replacing the CEO as dispatcher
Thin wrapper instruction files over modifying existing persona files — preserves TeamHQ as source of truth, avoids divergence
PGlite acceptable for v0.1 — real Postgres deferred to v0.2, not worth the setup overhead for proof of concept
Artifacts stay in docs/ on disk, not in Paperclip's issue documents — agents need to write files, not just update DB records
Pin to commit 7034ea5 for v0.1 — avoid upstream instability during proof of concept

tasks.task: Write tech approach for Paperclip setup — adapter config, instruction file structure, workspace config, Thomas orchestration loop design
Write Thomas's orchestration prompt — teach Thomas to use Paperclip API to drive the pipeline (create tasks, check status, assign agents, detect completion)
Set up Paperclip locally — clone, install, configure, create TeamHQ company, register 5 agents per tech approach
Validate end-to-end pipeline execution — create test task, observe 5-agent sequential execution, verify output quality and pipeline correctness
